nama_en: Supplication for Deep Understanding of Religion
arti_id: Ya Allah, pahamkanlah aku tentang agama (Islam).
arti_en: O Allah, grant him deep understanding of the religion and teach him its interpretation.
src: HR. Al-Bukhari no. 143, Fathul Barri I/244, dan Muslim no. 2477. Hadits Shahih. - Sumber: https://muslimah.or.id/9591-wanita-dan-majelis-ilmu.html - Hisnul Muslim
